# AZURE FINOPS COST MONITORING & GOVERNANCE PLATFORM Cloud cost visibility, resource governance and automated FinOps reporting. + Environment: Development + Primary Region: UK South + Project: FinOps Platform
This dashboard provides visibility into the Azure resources supporting the FinOps platform and complements Azure Cost Management reporting and the automated weekly cost analysis workflow.

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ "rg-finops-dev-uks"
| summarize Resources=count() by type
| order by Resources desc
content.title: Resources by Azure Type

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ "rg-finops-dev-uks"
| summarize Resources=count() by location
| order by Resources desc
content.title: Resources by Region

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ "rg-finops-dev-uks"
| extend BusinessCategory = tostring(tags["BusinessCategory"])
| extend BusinessCategory =
    iff(isempty(BusinessCategory), "Uncategorised", BusinessCategory)
| summarize Resources=count() by BusinessCategory
| order by Resources desc
content.title: Resources by Business Category

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ "rg-finops-dev-uks"
| extend
    Environment = tostring(tags["Environment"]),
    Project = tostring(tags["Project"]),
    CostCentre = tostring(tags["CostCentre"]),
    ManagedBy = tostring(tags["ManagedBy"]),
    BusinessCategory = tostring(tags["BusinessCategory"])
| project
    name,
    type,
    Environment,
    Project,
    CostCentre,
    ManagedBy,
    BusinessCategory
| order by name asc
content.title: Governance Tag Compliance

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ "rg-finops-dev-uks"
| where
    isempty(tostring(tags["Environment"]))
    or isempty(tostring(tags["Project"]))
    or isempty(tostring(tags["CostCentre"]))
    or isempty(tostring(tags["ManagedBy"]))
| project
    name,
    type,
    resourceGroup
| order by name asc
content.title: Resource Missing Required Governance Tags

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ "rg-finops-dev-uks"
| project
    name,
    type,
    location,
    resourceGroup
| order by type asc
content.title: FinOps Platform Resources

content.json:
### Cost Monitoring

Financial monitoring for this environment is provided by Azure Cost Management.

The FinOps platform includes:
+ Subscription-level cost analysis
+ £10 PAYG safety budget
+ Automated budget threshold alerts
+ Logic App email notifications
+ Daily Cost Management exports
+ Weekly serverless cost analysis

Detailed cost information remains available through Azure Cost Management, while the automated reporting pipeline processes exported cost data for week-over-week analysis.

### Weekly Cost Analysis
A timer-triggered Python Azure Function processes Cost Management export data from Azure Blob Storage.

The weekly report compares:
+ Latest seven days of available costs
+ Previous seven-day period
+ Total spending change
+ Percentage change
+ Top Azure services
+ Top resource groups
+ Largest service-level cost increases

Report output: `reports/weekly-cost-report.json`
